command:
set -eu
printf 'MODEL='
tr -d '\000\n' < /sys/firmware/devicetree/base/model
printf '\nARCH='
uname -m
printf 'FIRMWARE_METADATA\n'
while IFS= read -r line; do
 case "$line" in VERSION_ID=*|IMG_VERSION=*) printf '%s\n' "$line";; esac
done < /etc/os-release
